query: INSERT INTO businesses.staff_phone (business_id, linked_by, is_main, linked_at, approved_at, number_set_at, number_set_by) SELECT business_id, id, false, $3, CASE WHEN is_owner THEN $3::timestamptz END, $3, id FROM businesses.team_member WHERE id = $1 AND business_id = $2 AND removed_at IS NULL AND (is_owner OR confirm_and_billing) RETURNING id, approved_at IS NOT NULL AS "approved!"
